Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 cursor cur_interdesc is 
 select inter_desc
 from valid_interdictions
 where inter_code = :donor_interdictions.inter_code;
 szChkDgt varchar2(15);

BEGIN
 
 If :donor_interdictions.unit_id is not null then 
 if Length(:donor_interdictions.unit_id)=13 then 
 VALIDATE_UNIT_CHKDIGIT(:donor_interdictions.unit_id,szChkDgt);
 :donor_interdictions.dummy_unit_id:=:donor_interdictions.unit_id||ltrim(szChkDgt);
 else 
 :donor_interdictions.dummy_unit_id:=:donor_interdictions.unit_id;
 end if;
 End if;
 
 
 if :donor_interdictions.inter_code is not null then 
 open cur_interdesc;
 fetch cur_interdesc 
 into :donor_interdictions.inter_desc;
 if cur_interdesc%NOTFOUND then 
 :donor_interdictions.inter_desc := 'Not Available';
 end if; 
 if cur_interdesc%ISOPEN then 
 close cur_interdesc;
 end if; 
 end if; 
 IF :note_id is not null THEN 
 begin 
 select note into :last_note
 from central_notes
 where note_id = :note_id 
 and decode(chapter_id, 'ALL', :GLOBAL.chapter_id, chapter_id) = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and note_sequence = (select max(note_sequence)
 from central_notes
 where note_id = :note_id 
 and decode(chapter_id, 'ALL', :GLOBAL.chapter_id, chapter_id) = :GLOBAL.chapter_id);
 EXCEPTION
 when others THEN 
 null;
 END;
 END IF; 
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: RUNOTHER_FORM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE RUNOTHER_FORM (p_name in varchar2 , P_type in varchar2 )IS
p_exec_name varchar2(12);
author varchar2(10);
module_name varchar2(200);
mnemonic_name varchar2(8);

BEGIN
 
 if p_type = 'M' then
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select A.exec_name, b.descrip into
 p_exec_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 b.mnemonic = p_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;

 if p_type = 'X' then
 p_exec_name := p_name;
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select b.mnemonic, b.descrip into
 mnemonic_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 a.exec_name = p_exec_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;


 if :global.db_id = 'N/A'
 then
 begin
 select
 decode(substr(global_name,1,1),'W','D',substr(global_name,1,3))
 into :global.db_id
 from global_name;
 exception
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 end if;

 if substr(:global.db_id,1,1) = 'D' Then
 begin
 select Program_author into author from fcn
 where exec_name = p_exec_name ;
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 author := 'ISQA'; 
 End;
 module_name := module_name ||' By '||author;
 end if;

 p_exec_name := p_exec_name ||'.fmx';
 module_name := mnemonic_name ||': '||
 module_name ;
 :global.module_name := module_name;
 CALL_FORM( lower(p_exec_name));
 if form_failure then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
end;

PROCEDURE populate_donors IS
 szDonorID varchar2(10) := '';
 nTotalInterdictions number;
 nVisInterdictions number;
 nChkAllAccess number;
 h_query varchar2(500);
 v_ssn varchar2(9);
 szSSNMode NUMBER;
 szChapterid varchar2(10);
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date varchar2(20);

 cursor cur_inter (p_donor_id varchar2,p_local_date in date) is
 select count(di.inter_code)
 from donor_interdictions di, valid_interdictions vi
 where di.donor_id = p_donor_id
 and di.inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='INTUD')
 /*
 and di.inter_code in (select access_code_value
 from valid_acl_codes
 where access_class in (select access_class
 from valid_user_access_classes
 where user_id=:banner.user_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1))
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1))
 */
 and vi.inter_code = di.inter_code
 and vi.inter_type in (select code from valid_master_codes where
 code_type='INTUD')
 and p_local_date between vi.eff_date and nvl(vi.term_date,p_local_date+1)
 and p_local_date between di.eff_date and nvl(di.term_date, p_local_date+1);

BEGIN
 
 
 go_block('donor_interdictions');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 
 if IS_MULTI_CHAPTER then
 szChapterid := 'ALL';
 else
 szChapterid := :parameter.p_chapter_id;
 end if; 
 
 --:ctrl_block.donor_ssn := to_number(don_std.donor_ssn(:parameter.p_donor_id, :parameter.p_chapter_id));
 v_ssn:=to_number(don_std.donor_ssn(:parameter.p_donor_id, szChapterid ));
 :ctrl_block.donor_name := don_std.donor_name(:parameter.p_donor_id, szChapterid );
 :ctrl_block.donor_sex := don_std.donor_sex(:parameter.p_donor_id, szChapterid );
 :ctrl_block.donor_dob := to_char(don_std.donor_dob(:parameter.p_donor_id, szChapterid ), 'MM-DD-YYYY');
 :ctrl_block.donor_abo := don_std.donor_abo(:parameter.p_donor_id, szChapterid );
 --pitss synchronize;
 -- v_ssn:=lpad(to_char(v_ssn),9,0);
 
 


 szDonorID := :parameter.P_DONOR_ID;
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := to_char(v_local_time,'mm/dd/yyyy');
 else
 v_local_date := to_char(sysdate,'mm/dd/yyyy');
 end if; 
 
 if :global.first_time = 'TRUE' then

 open cur_inter(szDonorID,to_date(v_local_date,'mm-dd-yyyy'));
 fetch cur_inter
 into nTotalInterdictions;
 
 if cur_inter%notfound then
 show_error('18021');
 end if;
 
 if cur_inter%isopen then
 close cur_inter;
 end if;
 if nTotalInterdictions = 0 then
 show_error('18021');
 end if;
 
 end if;
 begin
 select distinct 1
 into nChkAllAccess
 from valid_acl_codes 
 where access_code_type = 'INTER'
 and access_class = 'ALL' --- SCR: 20601 (2013 R2)
 and access_class in 
 (select access_class 
 from valid_user_access_classes
 where user_id = :banner.user_id
 and to_date(v_local_date,'mm-dd-yyyy') between eff_date and nvl(term_date,to_date(v_local_date,'mm-dd-yyyy') +1))
 and to_date(v_local_date,'mm-dd-yyyy')between eff_date and nvl(term_date,to_date(v_local_date,'mm-dd-yyyy') +1);
 exception
 when no_data_found then

 when others then

 if nChkAllAccess = 1 then
 if get_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_term_toggle', label) = 'Hide Term' then
 set_block_property('donor_interdictions', DEFAULT_WHERE,
 'where donor_id = ' || in_quotes(:parameter.p_donor_id) || 
 -- ' and chapter_id = ' || szChapterid ||--in_quotes(:parameter.p_chapter_id) || 
-- ' and trunc(sysdate) between trunc(eff_date) ' ||
-- ' and trunc(nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)) ' || 
 ' and inter_type in (select code from valid_master_codes where
 code_type=''INTUD'')');
 elsif get_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_term_toggle', label) = 'Show Term' then
 set_block_property('donor_interdictions', DEFAULT_WHERE,
 'where donor_id = ' || in_quotes(:parameter.p_donor_id) || 
 --' and chapter_id = ' || szChapterid ||--in_quotes(:parameter.p_chapter_id) || 
 ' and ' ||'to_date(' ||''''||v_local_date||''''||',''mm/dd/yyyy'') between trunc(eff_date) ' ||
 ' and trunc(nvl(term_date,to_date(' ||''''||v_local_date||''''||',''mm/dd/yyyy'') +1)) ' || 
 ' and inter_type in (select code from valid_master_codes where
 code_type=''INTUD'')');

 end if;
 else
 if get_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_term_toggle', label) = 'Hide Term' then
 set_block_property('donor_interdictions',DEFAULT_WHERE,
 'donor_id = ' || in_quotes(:parameter.p_donor_id) ||
 --' and chapter_id = ' || szChapterid ||--in_quotes(:parameter.p_chapter_id) ||
 ' and inter_code in (select access_code_value ' ||
 ' from valid_acl_codes where access_code_type = ' ||
 in_quotes('INTER') || ' and access_class in ' ||
 ' (select access_class from valid_user_access_classes ' ||
 ' where user_id = :banner.user_id and to_date(' ||''''||v_local_date||''''||',''mm/dd/yyyy'') between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,to_date(' ||''''||v_local_date||''''||',''mm/dd/yyyy'') +1)) and to_date(' ||''''||v_local_date||''''||',''mm/dd/yyyy'') between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,to_date(' ||''''||v_local_date||''''||',''mm/dd/yyyy'') +1)) 
 and inter_type in (select code from valid_master_codes
 where code_type=''INTUD'')' );

 elsif get_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_term_toggle', label) = 'Show Term' then
 set_block_property('donor_interdictions',DEFAULT_WHERE,
 'donor_id = ' || in_quotes(:parameter.p_donor_id) ||
 --' and chapter_id = ' || szChapterid ||--in_quotes(:parameter.p_chapter_id) ||
 ' and inter_code in (select access_code_value ' ||
 ' from valid_acl_codes where access_code_type = ' ||
 in_quotes('INTER') || ' and access_class in ' ||
 ' (select access_class from valid_user_access_classes ' ||
 ' where user_id = :banner.user_id and to_date(' ||''''||v_local_date||''''||',''mm/dd/yyyy'') between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)) and to_date(' ||''''||v_local_date||''''||',''mm/dd/yyyy'') between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)) and to_date(' ||''''||v_local_date||''''||',''mm/dd/yyyy'') ' ||
 ' between trunc(eff_date) and nvl(trunc(term_date),to_date(' ||''''||v_local_date||''''||',''mm/dd/yyyy'') +1) ' ||
 ' and inter_type in (select code from valid_master_codes where
 code_type=''INTUD'')');
 end if;
 end if;

-- h_query := get_block_property('donor_interdictions', default_where);
-- show_debug_window(h_query);
 go_block('donor_interdictions');
 execute_query;
 --nVisinterdictions := to_number(get_block_property('donor_interdictions', query_hits));
 first_record;
 loop
 nVisinterdictions:=nVisinterdictions+1; 
 If :system.last_record='TRUE' then
 exit;
 Else
 Next_record;
 End If; 
 End loop; 

 if nTotalinterdictions > nVisInterdictions then
 :ctrl_block.warn_note := 'NOTE: Additional interdictions associated with this donor are not within your view level.';
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.warn_note', displayed, property_true);
 end if;
END;
